description: Header file defining the AudioGain class and related classes for managing audio gain configurations in Android, including methods for setting/getting gain parameters, conversions, and serialization.

classes.name: AudioGain
classes.description: Represents an audio gain configuration with methods to set/get parameters, compare, and convert to parcelable form.

classes.name: AudioGains
classes.description: A collection of AudioGain objects with utility methods for volume usage and equality checks.

methods.name: AudioGain
methods.description: Constructor initializing gain with index and input flag.

methods.name: setMinValueInMb
methods.description: Sets the minimum gain value in millibels.

methods.name: setMaxValueInMb
methods.description: Sets the maximum gain value in millibels.

methods.name: setStepValueInMb
methods.description: Sets the step value for gain adjustments.

methods.name: setMinRampInMs
methods.description: Sets the minimum ramp time in milliseconds.

methods.name: setMaxRampInMs
methods.description: Sets the maximum ramp time in milliseconds.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Serializes gain info into a string.

methods.name: setUseForVolume
methods.description: Marks gain as usable for volume control.

methods.name: canUseForVolume
methods.description: Checks if gain can be used for volume.

methods.name: fromParcelable
methods.description: Creates AudioGain from parcelable Aidl form.

methods.name: AudioGains
methods.description: Collection class for multiple AudioGain objects.

methods.name: canUseForVolume
methods.description: Checks if any gain in collection can be used for volume.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a gain to the collection.
